summary: The note surveys how small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) are adopting green innovations after September 2023, covering energy efficiency, waste reduction, sustainable sourcing, renewable energy, workplace initiatives, technology and green marketing. It ties each area to dated events, product launches and expert quotes. The conclusion is that sustainability is a fundamental shift in how businesses operate, and that green practices benefit both the planet and the business.
one_line: Overview of green innovation practices for SMEs since September 2023, from energy efficiency and recycling to renewable energy, technology and authentic green marketing.
key_facts: The International Small Business Consortium launched the Global Green SME Initiative on September 1, 2023.
Janet Mwangi, CEO of EcoTech Solutions, said at the kickoff webinar that sustainable practices will soon be required, not just recommended.
Stacy O'Connell, a green innovation consultant, defines green innovation as "the intersection of business strategy and environmental consciousness" (talk on October 12, 2023).
On November 3, 2023, GreenSME Energy Solutions announced the SmartEnergy Monitor, a device that lets SMEs track energy usage in real time.
The Green Economy Tax Act of 2023 introduced tax credits that reduce the financial burden of energy-efficiency upgrades such as retrofitting lighting, heating and cooling.
Richard Hansen, founder of Circular Solutions, spoke on the circular economy at a seminar on September 15, 2023, saying waste is now viewed as a resource that SMEs can turn into profit.

Sarah Thompson, a supply chain analyst, said at a sustainability summit on October 20, 2023 that engaging suppliers who prioritize environmental stewardship and fair labor ensures ethically produced products.
Solar Solutions Inc. launched a leasing program for SMEs on December 1, 2023 to lower the financial barriers to renewable energy adoption.
Environment First Technology launched Green Ideas on September 30, 2023, a platform where employees submit sustainability ideas that peers vote on, with the best ones implemented.
Kevin Lin, a tech entrepreneur, said at the CleanTech Challenge on November 11, 2023 that AI and the Internet of Things (IoT) are dramatically shifting the sustainability landscape.

Emily Roberts, marketing director at Brand Green, warned at the Global Marketing for SMEs Conference on September 25, 2023 that consumers can see through greenwashing and that marketing must reflect genuine sustainability efforts.
The note says SMEs are nimble and can adopt green innovations faster than larger counterparts.
Suggested waste measures include composting organic waste, recycling paper, glass and plastic, and rethinking product packaging.
